description: The editor's half of the contract: a floored sync call offers the bridge as an edit the reader accepts, wrapping the statement it escapes from and nothing else. Asserted as the file the edit produces, because a bridge is only a bridge in the right place.

diagnostics.message: Call to `risky` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is declared without a body — an ambient declaration, a `.d.ts`, or a value known only by its function type — and no mark, manifest, overlay or override colors it, so it is assumed to throw. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@nothrow/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.
